name: Soft Tissue Sarcoma of the Limb
tags: soft tissue sarcoma of the limb
definition: Malignant mesenchymal tumor of soft tissue, often presenting as a painless enlarging mass and requiring planned imaging and biopsy in a sarcoma center.

investigations.principle: MRI with contrast defines local anatomy; biopsy should be performed along a planned surgical tract by the treating sarcoma team.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Avoid unplanned excision of an unexplained enlarging soft-tissue mass.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mamsa-granthi phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Malignant mesenchymal tumor of soft tissue, often presenting as a painless enlarging mass and requiring planned imaging and biopsy in a sarcoma center.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
